name: ATLAS-ROUTE-ONLY-DIAGNOSTIC-NOT-RELEASE-QUALIFICATION
comment: Separately labeled route-discovery subset of ATLAS-FOUR-SEA. Removes all zoom actions and zoom/retention assertions because the permanent taskbar occludes those controls in the current packaged app. Preserves all baseline map geometry, local image readiness, real sea gates, preview/arc identity, actual mouse/index and keyboard interactions, and existing focus assertions. Use keep-going only to preserve real focus failures while discovering later routes; the command must still return FAIL for those assertions. Do not import into the main suite, replace ATLAS-FOUR-SEA, or report a passing subset as full atlas qualification. Intended actual normal window1280x720; the separate1364x1024 clipping failure remains valid. Original step labels retained for protocol comparison, so numeric gaps are intentional.
